record.name: Foxmorphos
record.title: Trickster of a Thousand Skies
record.anatomy_plan: Base body is a slender fox-like predator scaled to about 1.5 m long (Kitsune frame), but lightly built like a Microraptor for agile climbing and leaping. Forelimbs and hindlimbs are feathered-glider limbs (Microraptor wings) ending in chameleon-style gripping pincer feet for branch and wall climbing. The long fox torso tapers into a prehensile tail that splits into four main tail-limbs; each tail is lined with octopus-style muscular suckers on the underside and soft fur/feathers on top (Kitsune + Octopus). These tails act as extra arms for grabbing and as anchor lines while gliding. Skin and fur are overlaid with fine, scale-like patches that can change color and texture (Chameleon + Octopus), while the main coat shows ghostly white Kitsune fur with iridescent Microraptor feathers at joints. Head is fox-like with large ears, but with chameleon turret eyes mounted above the muzzle on small swiveling stalks for all-around vision. Inside the mouth is a sticky, extensible tongue shaped from chameleon mechanics but powered by octopus musculature. Kitsune mythic influence runs through the nervous system: specialized chromatophore clusters and feather-fiber filaments broadcast foxfire-like light patterns that trick vision and create illusions rather than true magic. Overall: an arboreal/ruin-climbing trickster glider that mixes fox cunning, dinosaur agility, lizard stealth, and cephalopod flexibility.

abilities.name: Foxfire Mirage
abilities.blurb: Glowing tail suckers flash foxfire that makes enemies chase bright fakes instead of the real fox.

abilities.name: Quad-Wing Ghost Glide
abilities.blurb: It leaps, spreads feathery limbs to glide in silence, then color-shifts to seem to vanish mid-air.

abilities.name: Tongue-Tether Pounce
abilities.blurb: A sticky lightning tongue zaps out, yanks a target closer, and sets up a surprise fox pounce.

abilities.name: Many-Tail Gripstorm
abilities.blurb: Four sucker tails snap out to grab walls, branches, or foes, turning the whole area into a sticky trap.

strengths: Excellent at ambushes with camouflage and illusion-like light tricks
Can climb almost any surface and glide between perches for hit-and-run attacks
Slippery fox-octopus body squeezes through tiny gaps, sees almost all around, and vanishes with skin that shifts colors.
weaknesses: Low raw armor; strong direct hits from heavy bruisers or falling debris can defeat it fast
Needs shade or damp air, or its color tricks fade and its skin feels stiff and crackly.
Eye-fooling copies miss noses and sonar, glides need high places, and its grabby tails snag in thorns or nets.
record.visual_spec: Fox-like quadruped body about 1.5 meters long, lean and flexible, standing lightly on four feathered limbs. Each limb has sleek, crow-like black and blue iridescent feathers fanning from elbows and knees, forming four glider wings when spread. Feet are chameleon-style pincer claws, two toes forward and two back, with rough pads for gripping bark and stone. The torso is covered in short, snow-white fox fur with faint silver swirls, broken at shoulders and hips by patches of glossy, raven-feather plumage that shimmers blue-green in the light. Along the flanks and neck, small chameleon-like scales peek through the fur, their colors slowly sliding between teal, amber, and mossy green. The head is a narrow white fox muzzle with a black nose and a small line of sharp teeth, crowned by tall, triangular ears dusted with dark tips. Above the muzzle rise two small chameleon turret eyes on short, scaly stalks; each eye is big, round, and emerald with slit pupils, able to swivel in different directions. From behind, instead of one tail, four long fox tails fan out, each as long as the body. The top half of each tail is fluffy white fur with streaks of black and midnight blue feathers; the underside is bare, octopus-like skin lined with neat rows of pale suction cups. At the tip of each tail, the fur thins into a soft, glowing tuft where pale blue-white foxfire light pulses softly, sometimes flaring into quick, ripple-like flashes that echo along the feathers and skin. The main body skin under the fur can shift color and texture: in forest it shows mottled greens and browns, in stone ruins it becomes gray and dusty. The creature’s back and limbs are patterned with faint ripple bands, like water-light, that can brighten or fade. When it glides, all four feathered limbs stretch wide, showing a dark, glossy wing surface with subtle rainbow sheen, while the four tails stream behind like glowing, ribboned comets, suckers flexing and gripping any passing branch or ledge. Overall look: a sleek, snow-white fox crossed with a raven, a chameleon, and an octopus, built to cling to walls and leap silently through tangled ruins and jungle canopies.
record.fun_fact: Foxmorphos swivels its eyes two ways at once while its glowing tails trace bright foxy shadows on the walls.
